metric_status: Exploratory; both included vintage groups have been inspected.
competing_nondefault: voluntary payoff before or at horizon
ipcw_assumption: Marginal independent censoring, estimated as a discrete-time reverse Kaplan-Meier curve within each evaluation period; no truncation or conditional censoring model.
concordance: Cause-specific Harrell concordance using 36-month predicted cumulative incidence as the risk score; payoff and other termination are censored.
limitations: Censoring may depend on borrower and loan characteristics; marginal IPCW can be biased if independent censoring fails.
C-index treats competing payoff as censored and is not a competing-risk concordance estimand.
Acquisition histories cannot recover unobserved pre-acquisition performance.
Metrics are exploratory, not confirmatory, because the evaluation vintages were previously inspected.
